title: Print Job Create Request
description: External v1 command for queuing a system-generated print job against an existing packaging unit and an explicitly selected printer.
$comment: The request contains only references needed by ops-core to generate the immutable payload. print_job_id, status, payload and render policy remain server-owned response fields.

qr_registry_id.description: Existing QR registry row for BOX print jobs; omitted where the packaging policy does not render QR.

trade_item_id.description: Trade item whose immutable packaging/label policy is used to generate the payload.

printer_device_id.description: Registered printer identifier. Exactly one printer target must be supplied.

printer_device_code.description: Registered printer code. Exactly one printer target must be supplied.
